test_title: PYST 20: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight professors of a college namely, X, Y, Z, A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a square table in such a way that four of them sit at four corners of the table while the other four sit in the middle of each of the four sides facing each other. C sits to the immediate right of A who faces Z. E sits opposite to X who sits to the immediate right of Y. B sits to the immediate left of Y and opposite to C. Who among the following faces Y?
solution: Given: Eight professors of a college namely, X, Y, Z, A, B, C, D and E are sitting around a square table 1) C sits to the immediate right of A who faces Z. 2) B sits to the immediate left of Y and opposite to C.
